spans.s:
n. (-ञ्छं)
Gathering grains.
E.
उछि to glean, and घञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
Gathering grains of corn in market places, &c. gleaning.
E.
उछि to glean, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति)
A gleaner, one who lives by gleaning.
E.
उञ्छ and वृत्ति practice.

n. (-लं)
Gleaning corn or grains.
E.
उञ्छ gathering grain, and शिल gleaning corn.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
One who lives by leaning, &c.
E.
उञ्छ and शील who practices.
